resolutionOrder.value: Tether on tanks+healers or DPS, then statue knockback.
Read true/lie; resolve Fire (spread/stack) and Blizzard.
Line up east-west; 4 beams from the statue.
Non-beamed players soak the 4 towers: the nth non-beamed player from the west takes the nth tower from the west.
Double-Trouble Trap cast ends: debuff on 1 tank/healer + 1 DPS; split west/east to take stack + knockback.
Trap debuff expires: groups get knocked across; then Mystery Magic (Blizzard + Thunder), dodge by the tells.

whyItWorks.value: Tanks+healers always work on the west side and DPS on the east, so nobody needs a callout: Fire (its markers plus the true/lie tell) only decides spread or stack, and Ice only decides north or south on your own side. The fixed west-to-east beam line puts the 4 towers in a known row, so "the nth player without a beam takes the nth tower" resolves at a glance. The trap pass reuses the same split, so each holder has their own group to share the stack. The holder waits outside the target circle because the debuff's knockback should throw their group across the arena.
whyItWorks.note: Drafted by Claude 2026-11-06; Owner confirmed 2026-11-07 (review items 18-25). Reasoning only; adds no positions or timings. Knockback reason from owner.

whyItWorks.value: Tethers split by group, so in each round one group spreads while the other takes the gravity orb to the middle, and the groups swap for round 2. Round 1 resolves south and round 2 north, so the two Graviga puddles end up at opposite ends. Because round 2 is round 1 flipped, everyone has a mirrored pair of spread slots (MT↔D1, OT↔D2, H1↔D3, H2↔D4). The west/east trap pass reuses the group split, and the knockback carries each group into its own puddle: tanks+healers north, DPS south. The puddles are soaked as a light party. Like keeping the trap debuff alive and taking all the Tele-trouncing arrows, this is required to see P3. Missing it doesn't stop P1 or P2.
whyItWorks.note: Drafted by Claude 2026-11-06; Owner confirmed 2026-11-07 (review items 18-25). Reasoning only; adds no positions or timings. Soak reasoning from owner; the P3-prerequisite detail is from the video (corrects the earlier "fake ending" wording).

whyItWorks.value: Each arrow pair maps to one framed tile pair, so you find your spot by following your own arrows instead of waiting for callouts. The post-teleport spread is fixed by role: melee inside so everyone can keep hitting the boss, ranged outside, and no tethers need checking. The final spread and stack use fixed waymark spots (melee at 1–4, ranged on the cardinal edges; tanks+healers stack at 3, DPS at 1).
